statement: Every result is about the models (L1 contracts and the reviewed L2 machines); none is a property of the product at pin 3eaa79cf.

baseline.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json

control_f0304_store_no_adopt.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0304_store_no_adopt -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0304_store_no_adopt.what: store_edge swallows the duplicate over a temporal edge's marked row and never adopts it, so the triple's last temporal delete deletes the stored edge (nodes_edges.py:2560-2588)

control_f0505_marker_predicate.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0505_marker_predicate -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0505_marker_predicate.what: the deleters' marker test is IsTemporalMarked's %Get("temporal") = 1, true for JSON true, 1 and "1", so an explicit {"temporal": 1} edge is deleted by the temporal side (Adjacency.cls:736-748)

control_f0507_purge_keeps_rows.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0507_purge_keeps_rows -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0507_purge_keeps_rows.what: TemporalIndex.Purge is EraseAll: every temporal global goes and no marked row is retracted (TemporalIndex.cls:381-392, 808-811)

control_fc0501_refused_write_partial.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_fc0501_refused_write_partial -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_fc0501_refused_write_partial.what: WriteStores sets tout/tin/bucket before AssertTemporalRow, whose refused edge INSERT throws, and no transaction takes them back (TemporalIndex.cls:80-111; Adjacency.cls:597-608)

control_hd0302_delete_removes_row.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_hd0302_delete_removes_row -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_hd0302_delete_removes_row.what: delete_edge deletes the triple's row, marked or adopted, while its timestamps remain (nodes_edges.py:1414-1433)

control_fc1203_prefix_from_node_rows.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_fc1203_prefix_from_node_rows -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_fc1203_prefix_from_node_rows.what: EraseNodes selects the prefix's ids from Graph_KG.nodes only, so a temporal-only edge (no row, no endpoint rows) is never erased (Eraser.cls:322-348; TemporalIndex.cls:400-453)

control_fc0301_adopt_after_commit.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_fc0301_adopt_after_commit -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_fc0301_adopt_after_commit.what: create_edge commits the guarded insert, then adopts the marked row in a statement of its own; a temporal delete in between leaves the call answering False with no edge (nodes_edges.py:1236-1252)

control_f0303_direct_delete_keeps_stmt.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0303_direct_delete_keeps_stmt -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0303_direct_delete_keeps_stmt.what: delete_edge is a plain SQL DELETE: ^IVG.Ledger("stmt") and ("tuple") stay live, and a re-created edge inherits the statement (nodes_edges.py:1414-1433; cf. Eraser.cls:641-683)

control_f0305_chunks_commit_alone.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0305_chunks_commit_alone -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0305_chunks_commit_alone.what: outside a caller's transaction the server loader runs on the engine's Native API connection (another process), so each chunk's TCOMMIT is durable on its own (nodes_edges.py:1715-1757; EdgeScan.cls:352, 424)

control_f0501_update_counted_again.command: bash experiment/playbook-completion/tools/locks.sh heavy timeout 3600 cargo verus verify --offline --fwd-verus-args-to roots --features control_f0501_update_counted_again -- --no-cheating --triggers-mode silent --time-expanded --output-json
control_f0501_update_counted_again.what: an update-mode write skips the collision check and $Increments bucket, tagg count and sum again (TemporalIndex.cls:80-118)
